name: Document OCR Mindee
description: Document OCR integration with the Mindee document-parsing API.
project_description:
Document OCR integration with Mindee. Mindee - Accurate and lightning-fast document parsing API.

 Supports the following APIs:

 

 Configuration 
 Configure the Document OCR Mindee at ( /admin/config/structure/document-ocr ). Requires Document OCR module.

 1. Create API Key here 

2. Get API key and create JSON file and store your credentials as follows:

 {

 "apikey": "[API-KEY]"

} 

 4. Upload it to the private directory `private://document-ocr/mindee-credentials.json`

5. Point to the credentials file when adding Mindee processor

6. You should be all set to use Mindee integration
